name: Wankendorf (Germany)
description: Quartered white and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Wankendorf (ears of wheat and an oak leaf on blue divided by a chequy bend).
history: Municipal flag of Wankendorf; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Wankendorf arms — ears, oak leaf and chequy bend
